text: At its meeting of February 15, 2018 the Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto, with respect to Item CT25.1, requested the Policies and Priorities Committee to consider and provide input to staff on the marketing and branding strategy.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the strategy contained in the Confidential Attachment (March 21, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment (March 21, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto remains confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
